# Grav CMS Component Library

> Tested, reusable blueprint fragments, Twig partials, page types and system practices for Grav CMS 1.7 and 2.x. Each pattern is a folder with a machine-readable pattern.yaml (when to use it, the exact import@ and include snippets, the data it stores, the problems it solves and how to verify it).

Start with AGENTS.md for how to choose and apply patterns. catalog.json lists every pattern with its import type, include path and raw file URLs. Grav-specific rule that breaks most generated blueprints: import@ goes on the receiving field (a sibling of type:), never inside its fields: list.

## Guides

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/AGENTS.md): how an AI agent should select, apply and verify patterns
- [Pattern spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/docs/PATTERN_SPEC.md): folder layout, manifest keys, blueprint and template rules
- [catalog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/catalog.json): every pattern, machine-readable
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/README.md): install, use with or without the plugin

## Theme patterns

- [Author registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/theme/author-registry/pattern.yaml): A list of authors kept once in the theme settings, a page field that picks one by ID with options read live from that list, and an author card partial.
- [Data layer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/theme/datalayer/pattern.yaml): A site-agnostic window.dataLayer helper loaded in the head, configured from theme settings through a JSON block, with declarative data-datalayer-event attributes instead of inline scripts.
- [Footer columns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/theme/footer-columns/pattern.yaml): Footer link columns where each column owns its heading and links, plus an optional trusted-HTML embed column, social links and a note line with {year}.
- [Head and body-end scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/theme/head-scripts/pattern.yaml): Two trusted-HTML theme settings for vendor snippets (analytics, tag managers, chat widgets), rendered in the right place, with a per-page off switch.
- [HERE map with conditional loading](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/theme/map-here/pattern.yaml): HERE Maps settings in the theme, a loader that adds the map scripts only on pages that show a map, and a map script that reads its settings from JSON and supports linked markers.
- [Schema.org graph](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/theme/schema-graph/pattern.yaml): One linked JSON-LD @graph per page (Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, the page, plus BlogPosting and Place when they apply), with site-wide defaults in the theme and a per-page Schema.org tab.
- [Site logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/theme/site-logo/pattern.yaml): One upload field for the site logo, stored outside the theme folder, with a home-link partial and a URL helper shared with Schema.org output.

## Page patterns

- [Call-to-action rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/page/cta-rows/pattern.yaml): Editor-managed full-width rows, each with a heading, markdown text, an optional image and one button.
- [Embeds and page scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/page/embed-block/pattern.yaml): Structured fields for third-party embeds (an iframe by URL with a required title and a shape, or a trusted HTML snippet) and page-only scripts, so embed code and Twig stay out of page content.
- [Header image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/page/header-image/pattern.yaml): A per-page header image with alt text and a show/hide switch, rendered as a responsive, eagerly loaded, high-priority image.
- [Hero actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/page/hero-actions/pattern.yaml): A primary and an optional secondary button under the page heading, each rendered only when complete.
- [Map location](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/page/map-location/pattern.yaml): Coordinates, a pin title and a summary on any page, so the page appears on Map pages and gets a Place entity in structured data, with no extra markup of its own.
- [Page heading and title tag](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/page/page-heading/pattern.yaml): Separate SEO title, visible H1, subtitle and byline fields, rendered as an <hgroup> and a <title> element with sensible fallbacks.
- [Quick actions (link blocks)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/page/quick-actions/pattern.yaml): A navigation block of shortcut cards (label, icon, one-line description) in two to four columns.
- [Tiles (card grid)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/page/tiles/pattern.yaml): An editor-managed grid of cards with widths, icons, markdown text, images, an optional whole-card link and a button, plus a hook for tile types that other templates render.

## Page types

- [Bookable tour or experience](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/page-type/bookable-tour/pattern.yaml): A page type for a tour or experience with a structured weekly schedule, price and availability, ordered stops, a booking widget from page/embed-block, and TouristTrip structured data with an Offer and itinerary.
- [Job listing and postings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/page-type/job-listing/pattern.yaml): Two page types, a jobs page that lists its open child postings automatically and a job posting with employment type, location, pay, closing date and JobPosting structured data.
- [Map page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/page-type/map-page/pattern.yaml): A page type that pins every page with a Map Location plus optional extra pins, lists the same places under the map with "Show on map" buttons, and outputs them as a Schema.org ItemList.
- [Modular page with a general-purpose section](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/page-type/modular-page/pattern.yaml): A modular parent template that renders its intro and every module with a linkable id, and a general-purpose "section" module built from page/tiles and page/cta-rows.

## System patterns

- [Plugin settings that work in Admin2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/system/admin2-plugin-forms/pattern.yaml): How a plugin's settings form behaves in Grav 2's Admin2 (an API client that reads saved YAML), and the event wiring that keeps derived or read-only values correct in both Admins.
- [Compatibility flag](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/system/compatibility-flag/pattern.yaml): Declare the Grav generations a plugin or theme was tested on with compatibility.grav, record the exact versions in a comment, and keep dependencies for minimum versions.
- [Dynamic select options (data-options@)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/system/dynamic-options/pattern.yaml): Build a select's options from site data with data-options@ and a static provider on the theme or plugin class, registered for Grav 2's provider allowlist.
- [Environments and secrets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/system/environments-and-secrets/pattern.yaml): Use Grav's per-host environment folders for production, staging and local settings, keep salts, keys and accounts out of the repository, and never let local copies talk to live services.
- [Front-end output guards for injecting plugins](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/system/frontend-output-guards/pattern.yaml): The checks a plugin should pass before injecting scripts into rendered pages, HTML responses only, privacy signals, and staff accounts in both Grav 1.7 and Grav 2 permission models.
- [Twig template hygiene for Grav 2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/system/template-hygiene/pattern.yaml): The template rules every pattern here follows, checkable on any theme with `bin/plugin component-library lint <path>`.
- [Twig in page content on Grav 2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subschema-LLC/grav-cms-component-library/main/patterns/system/twig-in-content/pattern.yaml): Keep Twig out of page content by moving dynamic parts into header fields and templates; when content Twig is genuinely needed, widen the sandbox narrowly in security.yaml or from a plugin.
